title: Greek Jazzy Risotto
description: A flavorful and gluten-free risotto dish, blending the freshness of Greek herbs with the unique taste of jazzy ingredients.
instructions: In a large skillet, sauté 1 cup of rice in 2 tbsp of greek until lightly toasted.
Add 1 cup of jazzy to the skillet and stir well.
Add 2 cups of risotto to the skillet and stir well.
Add the hot water to the skillet, 1 cup at a time, stirring continuously.
Cook for 15-20 minutes or until the risotto is creamy and tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
